tags.name: ApplicationDenialIdentityVerification
tags.description: [Account/OnboardingDenial] Customer's initial application or pre-approval attempt was rejected specifically because the system could not verify their identity (ID check, SSN verification, or selfie-match failure). Examples: Can you help me resolve the identity check denial? | I uploaded my driver's license but got a denial for identity verification error.

tags.name: ResetPassword
tags.description: [Account/AccountAccessAndProfile] Customer needs to change an existing password or recover access because they have forgotten their current password. Examples: Can you help me change my password? | How do I create a new password? I can't remember my old one.

tags.name: IncomeVerificationIssue
tags.description: [Account/IncomeVerification] Customer is experiencing difficulties with the income verification process required for their Flex credit line. This includes system failures during the verification step, rejection of submitted paystubs/documents, or questions about how to prove their earnings through bank data or employer portals. Examples: How do I link my payroll account so you can verify how much I make? | I need to submit my bank statements for income review; where do I send them?

tags.name: AccountIneligibleInfo
tags.description: [Account/SuspensionLifecycle] Customer was previously able to use Flex but is now being told they are ineligible, often due to a fixable account state like a past-due balance or a missed repayment from a previous cycle. Examples: I have a 'Not Eligible' notice in my dashboard even though I was pre-approved earlier. | I used Flex last month, why am I suddenly ineligible to pay my rent now?

tags.name: RetrieveUsername
tags.description: [Account/AccountAccessAndProfile] Customer has forgotten the username associated with their account and needs assistance identifying which email or ID they used to sign up. Examples: Can you help me find my username? | Can you tell me what username is linked to my phone number?

tags.name: ApplicationDenialInfo
tags.description: [Account/OnboardingDenial] Customer wants to know the general reason why their initial application for Flex was rejected during the pre-approval process, excluding identity-specific reasons. Examples: Can you tell me the reason my application was rejected? | I got denied—what happened?

tags.name: AccountSuspensionInfo
tags.description: [Account/SuspensionLifecycle] Customer's account has been formally suspended, which is a serious status usually resulting from bank disputes, policy violations, or manual reviews. The customer is seeking the root cause of this 'frozen' state. Examples: Can you check the reason for my suspension? | How long is this suspension going to last? I need to pay my rent.

tags.name: ReactivateFromBankruptcySuspension
tags.description: [Account/SuspensionLifecycle] Customer wants to reactivate their Flex account after it was suspended due to bankruptcy filing. Examples: Can I reactivate after a bankruptcy filing? | Can I reapply for Flex if I had a bankruptcy flag on my old account?

tags.name: ReactivateFromGeneralSuspension
tags.description: [Account/SuspensionLifecycle] Customer wants to reactivate their account after it was suspended or placed on hold for reasons other than bankruptcy (e.g., missed payment, overdue balance, income verification, dispute, or account review). Examples: Flex suspended me after I disputed a charge, but I want to fix it and use the service again. | How can I reactivate after being put on hold?

tags.name: ReactivateVoluntaryReturn
tags.description: [Account/SuspensionLifecycle] Customer wants to resume, reopen, or reapply for Flex service when their account is inactive due to being closed, canceled, deleted, or previously unused. The customer does NOT mention being suspended or placed on hold. Examples: Can I reapply for Flex? | Can you help me reactivate my profile? I closed it when I moved but now I'm back.

tags.name: ReactivationDenialInfo
tags.description: [Account/SuspensionLifecycle] Customer asks why their attempt to reactivate, reopen, or reapply was denied, rejected, or marked ineligible. Examples: Can you explain why my application to reopen my account was turned down? | I tried to reactivate my account but I was denied—can you tell me why?

tags.name: UpdateProfile
tags.description: [Account/AccountAccessAndProfile] Customer wants to update a profile field — address, email, name, or phone number — on their Flex account. The specific field should be extracted as an entity (downstream verification flow differs by field). Examples: I moved recently and need to change my home address in the app. | The street name on my profile is wrong, can you fix my address?

tags.name: AccountPauseAndResume
tags.description: [Account/AccountPauseAndResume] Customer wants to take a short-term break from using Flex for rent payments — typically one or two months — while keeping their account active and open. They plan to resume Flex rent payments after the break and are actively signaling return intent. Examples: I'd like to pause my Flex membership for April and come back to it in May — how do I do that? | Can I skip using Flex for just one month and then pick it back up the following month?

tags.name: CancelAccountAfterFailure
tags.description: [Account/Cancellation] Customer requests to close their account specifically because Flex failed to initiate or complete their rent payment on time, causing a loss of trust in the service. Examples: Because my rent was delayed, I need to close my account. | Flex didn't pay my rent on the 1st like you promised, so I want to close my account immediately.

tags.name: CancelAccountVoluntary
tags.description: [Account/Cancellation] Customer voluntarily ends their Flex membership or service plan — because they are moving out, relocating to a non-Flex property, never used the service, or simply choosing to step away. The request centers on stopping the active subscription for personal or situational reasons unrelated to any service failure. Examples: I'm moving out of my apartment next week, so I need to cancel my Flex account. | I relocated and no longer need Flex.

tags.name: DeleteAccountAndData
tags.description: [Account/Cancellation] Customer requests permanent deletion or deactivation of their Flex account profile, and may additionally ask that personal data, banking details, or account history be erased from Flex's systems. The emphasis is on removing the account record itself or exercising data privacy and erasure rights, beyond simply ending a membership plan. Examples: Can you help me delete my profile? I won't be using Flex again. | How do I shut down my Flex account?

tags.name: UnsubscribeOrDnc
tags.description: [Account/CommunicationPreferences] Customer wants to opt out of Flex communications — emails, texts, calls, or marketing outreach — whether through a casual unsubscribe request or a formal do-not-contact (DNC) designation. The focus is on reducing or eliminating Flex's outbound contact, ranging from stopping promotional messages to requesting permanent placement on a do-not-contact list. Examples: How do I unsubscribe from all these marketing communications? | Can you remove my phone number from your text message list?

tags.name: CannotReceiveVerificationCode
tags.description: [AppOrSystem/AppIssue] Customer is blocked during login or signup because the Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) or verification SMS is not arriving on their device. Examples: I can’t log in because the text code isn’t coming through. | I'm stuck at the verification screen because the text is taking too long.

tags.name: CannotSignup
tags.description: [AppOrSystem/AppIssue] Customer is a new user attempting to create an account but is blocked by system errors, eligibility issues, or confusion during the onboarding steps. Examples: I'm stuck on the second step of the application and it won't let me proceed. | It says I already have an account when I try to sign up for the first time.

tags.name: AppDownloadOrInstallIssue
tags.description: [AppOrSystem/AppIssue] Customer is unable to download the Flex app from the App Store/Google Play or is experiencing errors during the installation process on their device. Examples: Download keeps failing—can you help? | I can’t download the app—what’s going on?

tags.name: CannotEnterContact
tags.description: [AppOrSystem/AppIssue] Customer is physically unable to type or input their email or phone number into the text fields during the signup or login flow, often due to a UI glitch. Examples: I keep clicking the email box but it won't let me type anything in there. | It won’t let me enter my email/phone number.

tags.name: AppFreezingIssue
tags.description: [AppOrSystem/AppIssue] Customer reports that the app is unresponsive, stuck on a specific screen, or crashing immediately upon opening. Examples: Every time I open Flex, it just hangs and I have to force close it. | I'm stuck on a white screen and the app is completely unresponsive.

tags.name: CannotLogin
tags.description: [AppOrSystem/AppIssue] Customer is at the sign-in screen but cannot access their account due to generic errors, credential rejection, or the 'Login' button not working. Examples: I can’t log in—it's saying something is wrong. | I keep getting an 'Invalid Credentials' error but I know my info is right.

tags.name: RefundRepayment
tags.description: [ChargeAndRefund/Refund] Customer requests a refund of a repayment installment — the second or a subsequent scheduled payment made toward their Flex balance — after it has already been charged. Examples: Can I get my second payment refunded? | Can you refund the repayment you just pulled from my account?

tags.name: RefundDownpayment
tags.description: [ChargeAndRefund/Refund] Customer requests a refund of the down payment — the initial installment paid to Flex — typically because they changed their mind about using Flex for the month or because rent was never forwarded to the property. Examples: Can I get my first payment refunded? | Can you send back my downpayment? The rent wasn't paid so I want my money back.

tags.name: DisputedCharge
tags.description: [ChargeAndRefund/DisputedCharge] Customer contests a charge on their account because it is invalid or incorrect — either the charge should not have been applied at all (moved out, lease ended, account closed, or never activated Flex), or the amount is wrong (incorrect figure, duplicate transaction, or a late fee attributed to Flex's own payment delay). Examples: I moved out last month — why am I still being charged? | My lease ended, so this charge should not be there.

tags.name: RefundFee
tags.description: [ChargeAndRefund/Refund] Customer requests a refund of a fee charged by Flex — including late fees (applied by Flex or the landlord due to a delayed Flex payment), monthly membership or subscription fees, and miscellaneous charges such as processing, convenience, or eviction protection fees. Examples: Can I get a refund for the late fee on my account? It wasn't my fault the payment was delayed. | I want the late fee refunded.

tags.name: MonthlyMembershipFeeInfo
tags.description: [CreditAndPricing/FeesAndPricingInfo] Customer asks about the recurring monthly membership fee charged by Flex, including what it covers, when it is billed, or why they were charged. Examples: Can you explain the recurring fee that keeps my credit line active? | How does the monthly subscription work?

tags.name: DebtCollectionsInfo
tags.description: [CreditAndPricing/CreditInfo] Customer is inquiring about their account balance being moved to a third-party debt collection agency. This includes reacting to a collections notice, being contacted by an outside agency regarding a Flex debt, or asking for the contact information of the agency currently holding their delinquent balance. Examples: A debt collector contacted me about Flex—what's going on? | I just saw a collection from Flex on my credit report, how do I resolve this?

tags.name: CardProcessingFeeInfo
tags.description: [CreditAndPricing/FeesAndPricingInfo] Customer asks about the additional surcharge applied when they choose to use a credit card as their payment method for installments. This covers questions about the percentage-based fee for processing credit card transactions specifically. Examples: Can you explain the card payment processing charge? | Can you explain why the card fee is higher than the standard bill payment fee?

tags.name: DownPaymentInfo
tags.description: [CreditAndPricing/FeesAndPricingInfo] Customer asks general informational questions about the down payment (first installment), including timing, purpose, or how it works, without requesting a change to the amount. Examples: Can you explain my initial installment? | Does my first payment go directly to my landlord or to Flex?

tags.name: RepaymentInfo
tags.description: [CreditAndPricing/FeesAndPricingInfo] Customer asks general informational questions about their repayment installment(s), including timing, schedule, purpose, or how repayment works, without requesting a modification to the amount. Examples: Can you explain how the repayment part of the split works? | Can you explain my repayment schedule?

tags.name: CreditLineDecreaseInfo
tags.description: [CreditAndPricing/CreditInfo] Customer is reacting to a reduction in their credit limit and wants to understand why their available credit was lowered. This is usually triggered by Flex's monthly reassessment, risk factors, or changes in direct deposit status. Examples: Explain the reason for the reduction in my Flex credit line. | I didn't change anything, so why did Flex decrease my credit line?

tags.name: AdverseActionLetterRequest
tags.description: [CreditAndPricing/CreditInfo] Customer requests a formal 'Adverse Action' notice or a letter explaining the specific legal and credit-based reasons why their application was denied, their credit line was reduced, or their account was closed. This is often associated with Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) compliance. Examples: Can you email me the document that shows why I didn't pass the credit check? | Can you send me my adverse action letter?

tags.name: CreditLineGeneralInfo
tags.description: [CreditAndPricing/CreditInfo] Customer is seeking general information or education on how the Flex credit line functions, how the monthly reassessment works, or what their current available balance is. Examples: Can you explain how you decide my available credit each month? | Does my credit limit stay the same every month or does it change?

tags.name: CreditLineIncreaseRequest
tags.description: [CreditAndPricing/CreditInfo] Customer is proactively requesting an increase or upward adjustment to their current credit limit. This is a desire for more purchasing power to cover their rent or a higher credit ceiling. Examples: Can I get a credit line increase so I can cover my full rent? | Can you adjust my credit line to a higher amount? My rent went up.

tags.name: CreditReportingInfo
tags.description: [CreditAndPricing/CreditInfo] Customer is asking for information about how Flex reports to credit bureaus (Experian, Equifax, TransUnion), expressing concerns about a Flex-related entry on their credit report, or requesting to opt-out of credit reporting services. Examples: Can I opt out of credit reporting? | Does Flex report late payments to the credit bureaus or just the positive ones?

tags.name: FeeInfo
tags.description: [CreditAndPricing/FeesAndPricingInfo] Customer asks about a fee on their account — either inquiring about a specific charge they do not recognize, or seeking a general explanation of how Flex's fee structure works and what types of fees to expect. Examples: Can you explain this charge I just received? | I see a fee on my statement — what is it for?

tags.name: AccuseFlexFraud
tags.description: [EscalationAndFraud/Fraud] Customer directly accuses Flex of operating as a scam, running fraudulent business practices, or intentionally stealing money. The accusation targets the company itself rather than a third-party actor or unrecognized transaction. Examples: Flex is just a predatory business stealing from renters; you guys are fraudsters. | I believe Flex is running a scam.

tags.name: ReportFraudConcern
tags.description: [EscalationAndFraud/Fraud] Customer reports a suspicious or unauthorized charge on their account, or notices unusual activity they did not approve. The customer still has account access and is asking Flex to investigate the anomaly. Examples: I need to report some suspicious activity I noticed on my Flex account today. | There are charges on my statement that I don't recognize — can you investigate this?

tags.name: ReportIdentityTheft
tags.description: [EscalationAndFraud/Fraud] Customer reports that their personal information was used without their knowledge to open a Flex account, or that a third party has taken over their existing account through identity theft or account takeover. Examples: I need to report identity theft; someone used my social security number to open a Flex account. | I never signed up for Flex, but I just found out there's an account in my name.

tags.name: EvictionConcern
tags.description: [EscalationAndFraud/Eviction] Customer reports an imminent risk of eviction, legal action from their landlord, or has received a formal 'Notice to Quit' or 'Notice to Vacate' due to a delay or failure in the Flex rent payment process. This represents a critical escalation where the customer’s housing security is threatened. Examples: Can Flex provide a letter to my landlord so they don't evict me while the payment processes? | I have an eviction hearing coming up because of this late payment—please help!

tags.name: FlexAnywhereSupport
tags.description: [FlexAnywhere/FlexAnywhere] Customer needs help understanding or using Flex Anywhere, including accessing or using the provided virtual bank account (DDA) or virtual card details to pay rent at a non-integrated property. This includes questions about where to find the virtual account/card details, how the workflow works, bill amount entry, down payment requirements, or approval steps. Examples: Can I save the Flex Anywhere DDA details in my portal for future payments? | How do I manually enter my bill amount so I can get access to the Flex Anywhere card?

tags.name: SwitchFundingSource
tags.description: [FlexAnywhere/FlexAnywhere] Customer wants to change or switch between available Flex Anywhere funding options, such as using the virtual card (VC) instead of the virtual bank account (DDA), or vice versa. Examples: Can I switch my Flex Anywhere payment type to the virtual card before I submit my rent? | How do I switch from DDA to VC?

tags.name: VirtualAccountIssue
tags.description: [FlexAnywhere/FlexAnywhere] Customer cannot access, view, or successfully use their Flex Anywhere virtual bank account (DDA) or virtual card (VC) details. This includes missing account information, inability to see routing/card details, or problems using the provided virtual credentials. Examples: Can you help me find the Flex DDA info? I need to type it into my property website. | I can’t use the virtual account—the numbers are greyed out or missing.

tags.name: SplitWithOthersInfo
tags.description: [FlexProduct/FlexProduct] Customer asks how to split rent with roommates, partners, or co-tenants when using Flex. Examples: Can Flex split my rent between me and my roommate? | Can I add my roommate to my Flex account so we can pay together?

tags.name: LanguageSupport
tags.description: [FlexProduct/FlexProduct] Customer inquires about the availability of Flex's app, website, or customer support in languages other than English. Examples: Are there bilingual agents available to help me with my account? | Can I change the language settings in my profile?

tags.name: MoveOutSupport
tags.description: [FlexProduct/FlexProduct] Customer needs help managing their Flex account during a move — transitioning to a new address, updating property information, stopping Flex at an old address, or handling remaining balances at a previous property. Examples: Can I use Flex at my new address? | How do I transfer Flex to my new property?

tags.name: HowFlexWorks
tags.description: [FlexProduct/FlexProduct] Customer is seeking an overview of how Flex works — specifically how Flex pays the full rent to the property and the customer repays in installments, including the payment schedule and timing from down payment to final repayment. Examples: Can you explain how Flex works? | Can you walk me through the process of splitting my rent with Flex?

tags.name: ApplyForFlex
tags.description: [FlexProduct/FlexProduct] A prospective customer is asking about the steps, eligibility requirements, or process to submit a new application for Flex's rent-financing service. Examples: Can I sign up for Flex today to pay next month's rent? | Can you walk me through applying?

tags.name: ProvideFeedback
tags.description: [GeneralAndFeedback/Feedback] Customer shares general opinions, suggestions, compliments, or complaints about the Flex app, product features, or overall service experience. The customer is communicating a viewpoint or experience rather than requesting a specific resolution. Examples: Here's my feedback — this process for adding a property is really frustrating. | I have a suggestion on how you guys can make the downpayment process clearer.

tags.name: FeeFeedback
tags.description: [GeneralAndFeedback/Feedback] Customer voices dissatisfaction, frustration, or opinions about Flex's fees — expressing that charges are too high, too numerous, or unfair. The customer's goal is to share their view on the pricing model rather than take a specific action. Examples: Flex charges too many fees compared to other rent payment services. | I just wanted to let you know that I think the $14.99 fee is excessive.

tags.name: RequestHumanSupport
tags.description: [OutOfDomain/OutOfDomain] Customer explicitly requests to speak with a human representative or live agent, bypassing the automated system. The message carries only an escalation signal — a request for human contact — without additional context about the underlying issue. Examples: Agent | Can I talk to a human? This bot isn't helping me.

tags.name: GreetingOnly
tags.description: [OutOfDomain/OutOfDomain] Customer opens a conversation with a greeting or chat opener that contains no request, issue, or actionable content. These messages are non-informative and typically appear at the start of a live chat session. Examples: Hello | Hi

tags.name: PayDownPaymentAfterCutoff
tags.description: [Payment/Action] Customer wants to make their down payment after the monthly cutoff deadline has passed and asks whether rent can still be covered or what options remain. Examples: Can Flex still pay my rent if I'm submitting my first payment after the 5th? | Can you process my down payment even though it's late?

tags.name: RescheduleDownpayment
tags.description: [Payment/Action] Customer wants to change the scheduled date of their down payment — moving it earlier or later within the allowable window. Examples: Can I move my down payment to a later date? | Can I move my downpayment date to earlier so my rent gets paid faster?

tags.name: RescheduleRepayment
tags.description: [Payment/Action] Customer wants to move the scheduled date of their repayment installment to an earlier or later date. Examples: Can I change my repayment date? | Can I move my repayment date up so I can pay it off early?

tags.name: LinkCardIssue
tags.description: [Payment/Method] Customer is encountering technical errors or rejection while trying to link a debit or credit card to their Flex account. Examples: Every time I try to add my card, the app crashes or gives an error code. | I keep getting a linking error when adding my card.

tags.name: PaymentHardshipOrInsufficientFunds
tags.description: [Payment/Status] Customer acknowledges they do not have sufficient funds to cover a scheduled Flex payment and is asking for help, alternatives, or a payment arrangement. The signal is genuine financial difficulty — the customer is asking what options exist, not reporting a technical error. Examples: Can Flex still cover rent if I'm short on funds? | I can't afford the full payment this month.

tags.name: SettleOutstandingFlexBalance
tags.description: [Payment/Status] Customer wants to pay off a delinquent or past-due balance owed to Flex — including missed down payments, repayments, or membership fees — and is asking how to do so or requesting that the payment be processed. The goal is to clear the debt and restore the account to good standing. Examples: Can I clear my overdue Flex balance today to fix my eligibility? | Can I pay off everything I owe in one lump sum right now?

tags.name: ProcessPayment
tags.description: [Payment/Action] Customer wants to make a payment immediately or needs help processing a scheduled payment — such as a repayment installment or membership fee — that is not completing on its own. Examples: Can an agent help me run my repayment card on file today? | Can you help me submit my mid-month payment manually?

tags.name: StopOrPauseAutopay
tags.description: [Payment/Action] Customer wants to disable, pause, or modify automatic recurring payments on their account, or is having trouble changing autopay settings. Examples: Can I disable recurring payments? | Can I pause my automatic rent split just for this upcoming month?

tags.name: AdjustDownpaymentAmount
tags.description: [Payment/Action] Customer wants to change the amount of their down payment — increasing or decreasing the first installment — before or during the current billing cycle. Examples: Can I change how much my first payment is? | Can I reduce the down payment this month?

tags.name: AddBackupCard
tags.description: [Payment/Method] Customer wants to add a secondary backup payment method so that if the primary card fails, Flex can charge an alternative card. Examples: Can I link a second card to my profile just in case? | Can I set a backup card for autopay?

tags.name: SplitAcrossMultiplePaymentMethods
tags.description: [Payment/Method] Customer wants to pay a single Flex installment using two or more different payment sources — such as two cards, two bank accounts, or a mix of both. Examples: Can I divide this transaction across two accounts? | Can I pay half of my downpayment with my Chime card and the rest from my savings account?

tags.name: WithdrawFlexFunds
tags.description: [Payment/Status] Customer wants to transfer money out of their Flex Funds wallet back to their bank account, or is asking why an in-progress withdrawal has not yet arrived. Examples: Can I cash out my wallet balance? | Can you help me cash out my Flex credit balance?

tags.name: NsfErrorDespiteFundAvailable
tags.description: [Payment/Status] Customer received an NSF (non-sufficient funds) or insufficient-funds error on a Flex payment even though their bank account balance covers the charge. They are reporting the discrepancy and seeking an explanation or resolution. Examples: I definitely have money available, so why is it saying NSF? | I have over $1,000 in my account, so why is Flex declining me for NSF?

tags.name: PaymentDeclinedInfo
tags.description: [Payment/Status] Customer reports that a payment attempt — down payment, repayment, or membership fee — was declined or rejected during processing and wants to know why the failure occurred or what to do next. Examples: I tried to submit my down payment but it was rejected. | My bank blocked the charge from Flex—how can I get this payment to go through?

tags.name: ProcessDownpaymentManually
tags.description: [Payment/Action] Customer requests that an agent manually submit or trigger their down payment because it will not process through the app. Examples: Can someone process my down payment for me? | Can you manually process my downpayment? It won't submit in the app.

tags.name: PastDueFlexBalanceInfo
tags.description: [Payment/Status] Customer sees an overdue or past-due balance on their Flex account and wants to understand what it represents. The balance reflects amounts owed to Flex — such as unpaid rent credit advances, repayments, or membership fees — as opposed to rent owed to the property. Examples: Can you explain the outstanding amount on my account? | Can you explain the overdue credit balance showing up on my Flex dashboard?

tags.name: SplitIntoMoreInstallments
tags.description: [Payment/Action] Customer wants to break a scheduled payment — down payment or repayment — into smaller, more frequent installments spread across multiple dates. Examples: Can I break my repayment into smaller weekly payments? | Can I break my second repayment into two smaller chunks instead of one big one?

tags.name: RemovePaymentMethod
tags.description: [Payment/Method] Customer wants to delete or unlink an existing bank account or card from their Flex profile. Examples: Can I delete an old payment method? | Can you help me remove my payment method?

tags.name: AdjustRepaymentAmount
tags.description: [Payment/Action] Customer wants to change the amount of their repayment installment — increasing or decreasing the second or subsequent payment — on their current Flex balance. Examples: Can I change my repayment amount? | Can I lower the amount of my scheduled repayment?

tags.name: SelfSubmitSupport
tags.description: [Payment/Action] Customer needs help with the self-submit process — locating bank account details to enter into their resident portal, completing a self-submit payment, or resolving an issue with a returned self-submit transaction. Examples: Can you explain how to complete the self-submit step? | How does the self-submit process work?

tags.name: FlexBalanceMismatch
tags.description: [Payment/Status] Customer reports that the outstanding balance displayed in the Flex app does not match their own records or expectations. They are seeking a breakdown or reconciliation of the total amount owed — typically rent repayments or membership fees — to understand why the figure shown differs from what they calculated. Examples: Can you explain why my balance increased? | Can you explain why my total amount owed doesn't match my records?

tags.name: MissedPaymentInfo
tags.description: [Payment/Status] Customer received a missed-payment notification — via app alert, email, or text — about a scheduled installment (down payment, repayment, or membership fee) that was not processed. They want to understand what the notice means, which payment it refers to, or what consequences follow. Examples: Can you explain the missed payment email I received? | Can you tell me which specific payment the missed notice email is referring to?

tags.name: AddOrUpdatePaymentMethod
tags.description: [Payment/Method] Customer wants to add, replace, or update a payment method on their Flex account — either a bank account (routing/account numbers) or a debit/credit card. Examples: Can I switch to a different bank account? | How do I change the bank account linked to my payments?

tags.name: PastDueRentInfo
tags.description: [RentToProperty/BPStatus] Customer sees a past-due or unpaid rent balance at the property — shown in the resident portal or reported by the landlord — and wants to understand why rent appears overdue. The balance reflects what the property says is still outstanding, which may include base rent, utilities, or late fees. Examples: Can you check why my account shows overdue rent in the property portal? | I paid through Flex — why is my rent still overdue?

tags.name: RentStatementRequest
tags.description: [RentToProperty/BPStatus] Customer requests a formal record, statement, or receipt of rent payments Flex has made to the property on their behalf, for documentation or personal records. Examples: Can I get a PDF receipt or statement showing my rent was paid for January? | Can I get a statement showing my rent history?

tags.name: RentNotInitiatedAfterDownpayment
tags.description: [RentToProperty/BPStatus] Customer has completed their downpayment to Flex but Flex has not yet forwarded the full rent to the property. Customer is asking when or why Flex has not yet transmitted the rent payment to the landlord. Examples: Flex charged my down payment, but my landlord says they haven't received the rent. | Flex took the money for my first payment but my landlord is saying the rent is still outstanding.

tags.name: RentNotInitiatedBeforeDownpayment
tags.description: [RentToProperty/BPStatus] Customer has funds available and a downpayment scheduled with Flex, but Flex has not yet collected it, leaving rent unsent to the property. Customer wants to know when Flex will pull the scheduled payment so rent reaches the landlord on time. Examples: I have enough funds available for the down payment, why is the rent still showing as pending in the app? | I have money in my account, why hasn't Flex pulled the first payment?

tags.name: RentPaymentStatus
tags.description: [RentToProperty/BPStatus] Customer asks for a general status update on whether Flex has sent or processed the rent payment to the property, including questions about a status notification received from Flex. Examples: Can you check if my rent was processed? | Can you confirm if my rent is still processing or if it's been delivered?

tags.name: AddProperty
tags.description: [RentToProperty/PropertyAndPortal] Customer wants to add a specific property, apartment complex, or rental community to their Flex account, either because it does not appear in the search results or because they are moving to a new property. Examples: Can I manually enter my apartment's address if it's not in your database? | Can you add my apartment complex to Flex?

tags.name: NotSeeingPropertyOrPortal
tags.description: [RentToProperty/PropertyAndPortal] Customer cannot locate their apartment complex or property portal within the Flex app — it is missing from search results, has disappeared, or they are unsure whether their property is supported. Examples: I can't find my property anywhere in the app to set up my rent payment. | I can't find my property in the app.

tags.name: PropertyManagementUpdate
tags.description: [RentToProperty/PropertyAndPortal] A property manager, landlord, or leasing office representative contacts Flex to update high-level property data — such as management company ownership, adding or removing a building from the Flex partnership, or updating professional contact information for the property. Examples: I work for Greystar and need to remove a specific property from the Flex program. | I'm with the leasing office and need to update our property information.

tags.name: RenterPropertyUpdate
tags.description: [RentToProperty/PropertyAndPortal] A tenant contacts Flex to update their personal residency details — such as correcting an address, updating to a new unit within the same complex, or switching to a new apartment building. Examples: Can you correct my rental property details? | I just moved to a different unit in the same building and need to update my address in the Flex app.

tags.name: RemoveUtilityFeeFromRentAmount
tags.description: [RentToProperty/RentUpdate] Customer wants to exclude variable utility charges — such as water, trash, or sewage — from the total amount Flex is scheduled to cover, so that Flex finances only the base rent while the customer pays utilities separately. Examples: Can Flex cover just the base rent and not the utilities? | Can we lower the amount Flex is paying to exclude the sewage and pest control fees?

tags.name: RentTransactionRejectedInfo
tags.description: [RentToProperty/BPStatus] The rent payment Flex attempted to send to the property was rejected, returned, or canceled. Customer wants to understand why the transaction failed and what happens next. Examples: Can you tell me the reason my rent fulfillment was rejected by my complex? | I received a notification that my rent was declined.

tags.name: AddResidentPortal
tags.description: [RentToProperty/PropertyAndPortal] Customer wants to add, connect, or request support for a specific resident portal website or login system associated with their property that is not yet listed in the Flex app. Examples: Can I enter my portal website manually? | Can you guys integrate with my specific landlord's portal? It's not an option yet.

tags.name: UpdateRentAmount
tags.description: [RentToProperty/RentUpdate] Customer wants to update or correct the rent amount recorded in Flex — typically because their lease renewed at a higher rate, the amount was entered incorrectly, or the figure in the app no longer matches their current lease. Examples: Can you correct the rent amount on my account? | Can you update my rent amount in the app before the 5th?

tags.name: RentConfirmedInAppNotPortal
tags.description: [RentToProperty/BPStatus] Flex has confirmed the rent payment on its end, but the resident portal or landlord system does not yet show the payment as received. Customer wants to know why the two systems are out of sync or how long the update will take. Examples: Flex says my rent is paid, but my portal still shows unpaid. | Flex sent me a notification that rent was successful, but my landlord's website hasn't updated.

tags.name: ListedPropertyOrPortalIssue
tags.description: [RentToProperty/PropertyAndPortal] Customer can see their property or portal listed in the Flex app, but the information displayed is incorrect, the portal link is broken, or the property details do not match their actual lease. Examples: I can see my portal, but it's not loading properly. | I found my property, but the portal link you have listed isn't working.

tags.name: MicrodepositSupport
tags.description: [RentToProperty/PropertyAndPortal] Customer needs help completing the microdeposit verification step required by their resident portal — including finding the deposit amounts or verification code sent to the Flex account to confirm the bank connection. Examples: How do I check the microdeposit that was sent? | How long does it take for the microdeposit to show up?
